nodes.summary: If `w` has the coefficients of `q` scaled by an additive weight, then the same coefficient relation holds for their lawful formal exponentials. The coefficient hypothesis and `q`'s zero constant imply the required premise for `w`; no separate zero-constant assumption on `w` is needed.
